sources.title: Surapat27/distill-whisper-th-small · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Description This is a distilled Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) model, based on the Whisper architecture. It has been specifically tailored for Thai language speech recognition. The model features 4 decoder layers (vs 12 in teacher model) and has been distilled from a larger teacher model, focusing on enhancing performance and efficiency.
